_about: Hand fixes for the OCR Hindi meanings. Only two kinds are allowed: 'remove' deletes an exact string that is not part of the meaning (running headers, stray Sanskrit, scan noise); 'split' cuts one group at an exact string and gives the second part to another verse, dropping the Sanskrit in between. Nothing is ever added or reworded.

drop.18.73: The OCR line for 18.73 is garbled and the meaning of 18.74 is joined to it; both are left out.
